info.title: API.SH: Built In
info.description: The Built In API from API.SH: public Built In data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The Built In tech company directory by location, industry, size and hiring status, 20 companies per page: name, URL, logo, industries, employee count, office count and office locations, whether it is hiring, and a short description. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/builtin-companies

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code, default USA when a state is given.

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Industry alias, comma separated (for example fintech, healthtech, artificial-intelligence, cybersecurity).

parameters.name: hiring
parameters.description: open-jobs for companies with open jobs, remote for companies hiring remotely.

parameters.name: office_type
parameters.description: Office type, comma separated: fully-remote, remote, hybrid, office.

parameters.name: tech
parameters.description: Tech stack alias, comma separated (for example python, react).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A company's Built In profile: id, name, description, website, logo, headquarters address, founding year, employees, industries, number of offices, open jobs, open jobs by category, recently posted jobs and the profile's other sections. List all its jobs with /builtin/v1/jobs?company_id=<company_id>&all_locations=1.

Add `include=benefits` for the company's perks and benefits (`benefits`: section, category and the items listed, e.g. 401(k), health insurance, parental leave, remote work).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/builtin-company

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Company slug or its builtin.com/company/… URL.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Built In job: title, company (page, website, logo), employment type, locations with address and coordinates, applicant countries, salary range, industries, posted and valid-through dates, the apply link and the full description (HTML and text). Removed jobs answer 404. Give id/url, or q to open the first current result of a search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/builtin-job

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Job URL (builtin.com/job/…) or the job id (`id` is accepted too).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Instead of url: keywords; opens the first current result of that search (all /builtin/v1/jobs filters apply).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
US tech jobs on Built In with the job board's filters: remote, hybrid or office, category and subcategory, experience level, industry, company size, date posted, city, state and country with radius, skills, company and early-applicant jobs. Each job: `id`, `title`, `url`, `company`, `company_url`, `company_slug`, `logo`, `posted`, `workplace`, `location`, `salary`, `experience`, `industries`, `summary`, `skills`. `facets` lists every filter's values (aliases to pass back). 25 jobs per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/builtin-jobs

parameters.name: remote
parameters.description: remote, hybrid and/or office, comma separated.

parameters.name: experience
parameters.description: Experience aliases, comma separated (internship, entry-level, junior, mid-level, senior, expert-leader).

parameters.name: early_applicant
parameters.description: 1: jobs with few applicants so far.

parameters.name: all_locations
parameters.description: 1: jobs in every location (not only the country's).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
